question:
**Direction: Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.**

Pure
solution:
The correct answer is **"Tainted."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Pure** means free from contamination or impurities. (शुद्घ (बिना मिलावट का))

 
 
• **Example**: *This is **pure**__ orange juice.*
 
 
 
• **Tainted** means contaminated or spoiled. (दूषित या ख़राब)
 __
 
• **Example**: *This is **tainted**__ seafood.*
 
 
 
• Therefore, the antonym of **Pure** is **Tainted**.
 
• The correct answer is option 3.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Virtuous** means having high moral standards. (सदाचारी, सद्‌गुणी, गुणवान)
 
• **Foolish** means lacking good sense or judgement. (बेवक़ूफ़; बेअक़ल, बुद्धिहीन, विवेकहीन)
 
• **Humble** means having a modest opinion of oneself. (विनम्र, विनीत; घमंडी नहीं)
